title: Nicholson's Hardware owned by Lloyd Nicholson, purchased in 1948
description: Lloyd Nicholson, just discharged from the RCAF, purchased a building in 1946 that had been formally used as a dwelling and converted it into a hardware store. The building was once the home of John T. G. Carr, who moved the building back from Main Street, past the railroad tracks, to its current location. It was moved to make way for Carr’s general store, which is currently located where Day & Ross is. Lloyd and his wife, Hazel Ellis, lived over the hardware store until they built their home on the corner of Orser and School Street in 1954. (Photo courtesy of Terry Nicholson Logan)
